name: io.github.defcron/agent-evidence-utility
title: Agent Evidence Utility
description: Free MCP index for x402 APIs: CSV/ETL, JSON, invoices, PDF/OCR, XML, calendars, and weather.

tools.name: find_agent_apis
tools.description: Search paid CSV, JSON, OpenAPI/API-discovery, HTTP, security, calendar, document, invoice, text, and U.S. weather APIs by task. Returns up to five best-matching route URLs, seller prices, categories, and free examples; does not initiate payment.

need.description: Describe the task the API should help with.

max_price_usdc.description: Optional maximum seller price per request, in USDC.

category.description: Optional task category filter; valid values match the catalog categories.

tools.name: get_agent_api_details
tools.description: Return request fields when available, a free example when published, the OpenAPI link, seller price, and x402 notes for one API. Pass exactly one of id or endpoint_url from find_agent_apis. Does not call the endpoint or initiate payment.

id.description: Exact id returned by find_agent_apis, such as json-to-csv.

endpoint_url.description: Exact endpoint_url returned by find_agent_apis, such as https://agent-evidence-extractor.defcronyke.workers.dev/v1/json-to-csv.

tools.name: find_csv_import_apis
tools.description: Search this service's vendor CSV, preflight, schema validation, typed JSON import, batch import, and recurring CSV monitoring endpoints. Returns route contracts, prices, and free examples without processing CSV data or initiating payment.

tools.name: get_csv_import_api_details
tools.description: Return request fields when available, a free example when published, the OpenAPI specification, and x402 payment notes for one CSV endpoint. Does not call the endpoint or initiate payment.

id.description: Exact id returned by find_csv_import_apis, such as csv-preflight.
